about: The Entrance Hall of 1897 as points to earn (Godric's 1 on req 2610, 1 November 2026, under req 2312): a dropped glove, scarf, quill, mitten or cap lies on the flags; handed to the nearest prefect on the stair it sends a few stones up into his house's hourglass, once for each kind of thing, no race and no count. Tap id (prefect) waits on the Hall's page. The 1990s doings (broom cupboard, gate doors) stay in ground-floor.json and doors.json.

show: a woollen glove lies on the flags by the stair where somebody dropped it, the wet of the doorstep still on it
